caption: The drawing depicts a single teapot rendered in black and white, centered on a plain background. The teapot has a rounded body with an engraved decorative pattern on its side, a long spout extending from the left, and a large curved handle on the right that appears dark and distinct from the rest of the vessel. The lid of the teapot is domed with vertical indentations and is topped with a finial that has a pointed tip. The shading and highlights on the body of the teapot suggest a metallic surface, and the drawing is enclosed within a rectangular border that sits within a larger, blank margin.
title: Teapot
